caveat_text: Synthetic task family, not natural instructions: measures whether adaptation transfers, not instruction-following in the wild.

PEFT head-to-head was re-run after two scoring/training defects were found in prompt tuning, prefix tuning and adapters: their forward passes applied a SECOND cross-entropy shift (MiniGPT's loss is already aligned to the inputs, and the SFT loop passes labels shifted by one), and score_response sliced pred[-n:] which is off by one when a method prepends virtual tokens. Both are fixed and guarded by tests/test_act7.py. LoRA and full fine-tune route through MiniGPT.forward and were never affected, so 7b and 7d are unchanged.

final_train_loss is recorded for the head-to-head precisely so that a zero accuracy can be told apart from a failure to fit. prefix_tuning scores 0.0000 at train_loss=3.2576, i.e. it does not fit this budget; that is a measurement, not a scoring artefact.

SEED DEPENDENCE AT n=16: the n=16 row of icl_vs_sft returns IDENTICAL values across seeds 42/43/44 (0.0703 three times). With 16 examples and batch_size 16 there is exactly one batch per epoch, so the seeded shuffle has nothing to shuffle and the three runs are not independent. That row must NOT be described as n=3 with error bars; it is effectively n=1. Rows at n=64/256/512 do vary across seeds and are genuinely n=3.
The base model is frozen at the pinned canonical checkpoints; only the adaptation step is seeded. Seeds therefore vary optimisation order, not initialisation or data source.
ICL is scored teacher-forced with a demonstration drawn from a disjoint pool, so it is not comparable to the free-running generation numbers elsewhere in the project.

D13 (found by positive control before write-up): the original 4-shot ICL prompt is 328 tokens against a 128-token context, so truncation removed the demonstrations and the model was scored on a truncated tail. The scoring harness itself was verified sound -- an oracle emitting the correct answer scores 1.0 on BOTH the teacher-forced and the greedy path -- so the defect was in the prompt, not the metric. ICL is now fitted to the context window and every selected demonstration is asserted present in the model input. Because the ICL prompt does not depend on training-set size, it is measured ONCE; the earlier icl_4shot rows were four identical rows per seed presented as a curve and have been removed.

ICL is evaluated on a FROZEN model with a deterministic forward, so its three seed runs are bit-identical -- n=1 effectively, not n=3. The accuracy_runs triplet is retained for schema uniformity only.

Only 1-2 demonstrations fit the 128-token window and shot selection is cost-driven (cheapest first), so 110 of 128 items receive the single cheapest pool example -- an addition demo -- making it CROSS-task relative to the query. The clean same-task test is therefore the 18 addition items, whose per-task result is reported separately in icl_control.

D13 (superseded by the re-measurement): the original 4-shot ICL prompt was 328 tokens against a 128-token context, so truncation removed the demonstrations. ICL is now fitted to the context window with every selected demonstration asserted present in the model input. The 7b number in this file is the RE-MEASURED one.

The ICL control shows the model copies the demonstration's ANSWER as its first token on 18/18 same-task items (0/18 zero-shot). Read 7b as 'copied the format, not the operation', not as 'ignored the demonstration'.
groundedness against the supplied source, NOT factual truth against the world (no fact base available)
the candidate set is deduplicated, so an item may have 4, 5 or 6 distinct candidates; a flat 1/3 (or 1/6) would be wrong

the primary instrument is deterministic, so there is one measurement per item per condition: n = items, NOT items x seeds. Free-generation repeats are averaged per item before scoring. Contrast CIs resample ITEMS.
the argmax probability is low (a near-flat distribution), so the template echo is a MODAL effect, not a confident one
